newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends steady vs dlr, BCE lira futures active.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends steady vs dlr, BCE lira futures active.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed almost unchanged from its morning opening against the dollar as the U.S. currency regained slight early losses against the mark in Europe, dealers said on Friday.
The forint finished at 156.27/32 to one dollar, compared to 156.36/38 at the opening.
The forint floats within the central bank's 4.5-percent intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu.
"It was a quiet day," said Orsolya Liptai of Magyar Hitel Bank. "There was not much movement in the dollar/mark cross and certainly no domestic factors," she said.
The entry of the lira into the ERM and the strong weekend performance of the dollar ensured high turnover on the Budapest Commodity Exchange forex futures market, traders said.
The Italian unit featured strongly in the 9.75 billion forints turnover, as did the yen.
The lira, dollar and sterling all rose for most contracts while the mark, yen and Ecu fell.
